subject: Rufus
fact: Rufus is a powerfully built man of average height with blue eyes, a delicate nose, and golden blond hair.
source_quote: Rufus is a powerfully built man of average height with blue eyes, a delicate nose, and golden blond hair.

subject: Rufus
fact: Rufus is wearing white linen pants and a dark blue blouse that shows more of his chest than the Sequoia or anyone wants to see.
source_quote: He is wearing white linen pants and a dark blue blouse that shows more of his chest than the Sequoia or anyone wants to see.

subject: Rufus
fact: Rufus introduces himself as the military leader of the area.
source_quote: Rufus introduces himself as the military leader of the area

subject: Rufus asks Sequoia to explain what he has learned
fact: Rufus asks Sequoia to explain everything he has learned.
source_quote: asks Sequoia to explain everything he has learned.

subject: Burne
fact: Burne is a rather youngish-looking man with a slight build, long brown hair, green eyes, and an aquiline nose.
source_quote: Burne has a slight build, long brown hair, green eyes, and an aquiline nose.

subject: Burne
fact: Burne is wearing a mage robe with scuff marks and scratches on it.
source_quote: He’s wearing a mage robe with scuff marks and scratches on it.

subject: Burne reacts to meeting Sequoia
fact: Burne says, 'Rufus, why didn’t you tell me we had guests? I would have worn the proper attire.'
source_quote: Rufus, why didn’t you tell me we had guests? I would have worn the proper attire.

subject: Rufus responds to Burne
fact: Rufus says, 'It’s okay. You look fabulous. I am so sorry to tear you away from your experiments.'
source_quote: It’s okay. You look fabulous. I am so sorry to tear you away from your experiments.

subject: Rufus and Burne's relationship
fact: Sequoia immediately understands that Rufus and Burne are an item.
source_quote: Sequoia immediately understands that they are an item.

subject: Burne asks about the importance of the information
fact: Burne asks, 'So what’s so important?'
source_quote: So what’s so important?

subject: Rufus reveals concern about the Temple of Elemental Evil
fact: Rufus explains that the heroes have discovered that there may be a resurgence of the Temple of Elemental Evil.
source_quote: the heroes have discovered that there may be a resurgence of the Temple of Elemental Evil.

subject: Burne reacts to the Temple of Elemental Evil news
fact: Burne is horrified and says, 'That’s impossible.'
source_quote: That’s impossible.

subject: Rufus proposes reporting to Verbobonc
fact: Rufus says, 'My friends, if you were to find out that the temple was resurgent, that would be critical secret information. It would be essential that we present it to our boss in Verbobonc.'
source_quote: My friends, if you were to find out that the temple was resurgent, that would be critical secret information. It would be essential that we present it to our boss in Verbobonc.

subject: Rufus deputizes Sequoia
fact: Rufus says, 'I am deputizing you. As my deputies, you are required to talk to me first.'
source_quote: I am deputizing you. As my deputies, you are required to talk to me first.

subject: Rufus threatens arrest for non-compliance
fact: Rufus says, 'If you refuse my offer of being a deputy, I will have you arrested, or worse, if you explore the Moathouse.'
source_quote: If you refuse my offer of being a deputy, I will have you arrested, or worse, if you explore the Moathouse.

subject: Rufus mandates information sharing
fact: Rufus says, 'As my deputies, you are required to share any information with me, first. And then with anyone else.'
source_quote: As my deputies, you are required to share any information with me, first. And then with anyone else.

subject: Sequoia agrees to become a deputy
fact: Sequoia smiles and nods.
source_quote: Sequoia smiles and nods.

subject: Sequoia's intent to control information flow
fact: Sequoia decides that once he has information, he will decide what to share.
source_quote: Once he has information, he will decide what to share.

subject: Zinia decides to retrieve Calmer
fact: Zinia says, 'We need to go get our cleric, Calmer.'
source_quote: We need to go get our cleric, Calmer.

subject: Temple of St. Cuthbert
fact: The Temple of St. Cuthbert is a massive, imposing structure that is ridiculously too large for such a small village with so few souls.
source_quote: a massive, imposing structure that is ridiculously too large for such a small village with so few souls.

subject: Calmer

source_quote: We need to go get our cleric, Calmer.

source_quote: excitedly introduces him to Terjon.

subject: Terjon

source_quote: Whatever information you get must be shared with me and me alone. The safety of the good people of Oerth may hang in the balance.
